documentation_improvement.exact_delta_proposal: For a Runtime source-sync acceptance fixture, keep all persistent build caches outside the action package directory. The Canvas acceptance currently assigns `UV_CACHE_DIR` beneath `tmp_path`, then starts Action Server with `cwd=tmp_path` and `actions_sync=True`; uv creates directory symlinks in that cache, and Runtime source snapshots reject directory symlinks inside a package. Put the per-test UV cache in a sibling temporary directory outside the synced package root. For pinned browser proof, the existing test also selects `shutil.which("chromium")` as an explicit override: activate repository RCC, keep the lock-matched Playwright browser cache available, and use a controlled PATH that withholds system Chromium while retaining required tools; record the managed executable version and SHA-256 separately.
documentation_improvement.evidence: Exact-head test source lines 249-261 puts UV_CACHE_DIR at `tmp_path/uv-cache`; it later starts Action Server with cwd=tmp_path and actions_sync=True (lines 406-411). Attempt 3 created `uv-cache/wheels-v5/pypi/poetry-core/2.5.0-py3-none-any -> .../archive-v0/...`; Runtime source validation at action_server/src/actions/server/_action_package_handler.py rejects directory symlinks and server log records this exact failure. Playwright lock 1.62.1 requires Chromium revision 1234, matching prepared Google Chrome for Testing 151.0.7922.34 SHA-256 0b20b130e7edd9dd51873be867761295fe0cfad490c2b9a64f95bd3cfc08fa71. The minimal fixture fix moved both UV_CACHE_DIR and TMPDIR to `tmp_path_factory.mktemp("canvas-runtime-build")`, outside the action package source root; exact-head rerun passed.
